nom: PEACH & LILY Glass Skin Water-Gel Moisturizer

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/combination skin repeatedly say this sinks in without leaving shine, grease, or clogged pores, and several call it their best option for oily-prone skin; a couple with severely oily, acne-prone skin instead report it caused pimples.
segments.dry: A few reviewers with dry or more mature skin find it hydrating and smoothing, but others with dry or aging skin say it is too light and not moisturizing enough on its own, especially in winter.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as soft, non-oily, and well-suited to warm weather, though one with combination skin found it sticky and not hydrating enough.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often praise it as gentle, soothing, and non-irritating with no fragrance, though a couple note it stings slightly on application or is sticky enough to feel uncomfortable while drying.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (in their 50s and 60s) report brightening, reduced redness, and lighter dark spots over time, while one in this group felt it was too light to be sufficiently moisturizing for her skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging skin report brightened tone, faded dark spots, and reduced redness over months of use; no dissent on this concern beyond one mature reviewer finding it insufficiently hydrating for her needs.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe it as surprisingly hydrating for a lightweight gel, keeping skin moisturized through the day; several dissent that it is not enough on its own in winter or cold weather and needs to be layered with a heavier product.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness report it decreasing or becoming less noticeable with continued use, though one still has occasional redness remaining.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive or easily irritated skin describe it as soothing and non-flaring, crediting its fragrance-free, silicone-free formula; one reviewer notes it can sting slightly on first application.
concerns.spots: Reviewers mention dark spots and acne scars becoming lighter or less visible with regular use; no negative reports specific to spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report no new breakouts, some after months of daily use; however, several others describe breaking out badly, including cystic-type pimples, especially those with severely oily or acne-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently report the gel controls shine and does not leave an oily or greasy residue, describing it as ideal for humid or warm weather; no dissent found on this point.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky feel while drying
Not enough for cold or winter weather

extraits.texte: It's a great product but if you have acne prone severely oily skin it'll cause pimples for sure

extraits.titre: Lovely texture, but not moisturizing enough
extraits.texte: I would have loved this in my 20s and maybe 30s, but it is way too light for my more mature skin. On the plus side, it is a dream to apply. I love the gel texture and it sinks quickly into the skin. On the down side, it just isn't moisturizing enough. I feel like I need to reapply again. There are better options for me.

I really enjoy this moisturizer. It is very light and sinks into the skin quickly. I have sensitive and acne-prone skin and this does not irritate it. This is definitely not moisturizing enough for winter months for me, so I had to take off one start rating, but it works great for spring, summer, and fall.

This moisturizer does well for my super sensitive skin. I am 49 and have never found a moisturizer that doesn't cause me to breakout. I can use this sparingly on my face except for chin. My chin still breaks out. But I am hoping that the cleanser is just bringing out impurities. Maybe the moisturizer isn't the cause. I've been using this for about a month. The water based gel is lighter and doesn't feel as heavy or greasy as the non gel formulas that no doubt break me out no matter how lightweight they presume to be.

My favorite moisturizer! I'll never be without this now. I am 52 years young. People always think I'm in my 30s. Part of that is just good genes. Part is good skincare. I've taken care of my skin since I was 12. Peach and Lily however, has really helped my aging skin over the past year. It's brightened my skin tone, faded some dark spots taken out the redness, and just quenched my thirsty skin. I love the glass skin line most. I have people ask what I'm using and telling me they hope they age like me.

I love the whole glass skin line. My 52 year old skin has never looked better! I used to struggle with redness, enlarged pores, and dark spots. I still have a bit of redness occasionally, but very little. My dark spots are there, but much lighter now. My skin is much more hydrated now. Peach & Lily glass skin collection plus their matcha pudding cream are my go to for daily skincare habits. These products deliver results! Shipping is always quick and items are packaged well.

This is my favorite day-time moisturizer. My skin is dehydrated, sensitive and prone to breakouts from silicones and oils and this gel is a holy grail for me. The gel texture is lightweight and yet very hydrating. The clean and quality ingredients work perfect for my skin which is smooth and glowing now! Totally glass-skin! I receive a lot of compliments and questions about what moisturizer I use. So now you know my secret !
